source.listing_description:
Achieve flawless makeup application with the Jessup 14-piece brush set designed for foundation, powder, contour, eyeshadow, liner, blending, and highlighting. Soft synthetic fibres ensure smooth, smudge-free results for every look.

This comprehensive brush set solves the need for versatile, high-quality tools that cover every aspect of makeup application from base to detail. Whether applying foundation or precision eyeshadow, the brushes provide professional results with ease and durability.

Key Features

  • Synthetic Fibres: Soft yet resilient hair for smudge-free blending and long-lasting use.
  • Versatile 14pc Set: Includes 5 face brushes and 9 precision brushes for foundation, contour, powder, eyeshadow, liner, and highlighting.
  • Ergonomic Handles: 17cm / 6.7in handles offer a comfortable grip for precise control during application.
  • Multipurpose Use: Suitable for both liquid and loose makeup products ensuring flawless coverage and definition.
  • Durable Construction: High-quality ABS and synthetic materials for resilience and easy cleaning.
